title: View and Sorting are not being remembered
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

everytime I open Sonarr, the view and sorting in series come back to "table" and "added".

### Expected Behavior

Remember previous choice

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Windows
- Sonarr: 4.0.19.2991
- Docker Install: No
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: Chrome
- Database:
```

comments.author: augustuen
comments.body:
1. Those aren't trace logs
2. Sonarr does remember your selection. And considering neither table nor added is the default option, it sounds like it has remembered your selection, but for some reason it's not able to update it. 

Have you tried disabling browser extensions and/or privacy features in your browser?

comments.author: mynameisbogdan
comments.body: Sonarr uses LocalStorage to save your preferences.
